Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The plan.md provides clear mathematical formulation of the ELM method. CodeWalkthrough.md gives step-by-step usage instructions. Source code is well-documented with all components (edit vector generation, loss functions, LoRA training) understandable from documentation. Training hyperparameters are clearly specified. No major guesswork required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: requirements.txt specifies all packages with versions. Core dependencies are standard and installable. Pretrained models available on HuggingFace (baulab/elm-zephyr-7b-beta). Evaluation data included in repository. WMDP bio-forget corpus is gated but pretrained models enable evaluation replication. No unresolved dependency conflicts.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Random seeds properly set for reproducibility. Replicated WMDP accuracy (36% bio, 30% cyber) consistent with reported results (29.7-33.7% bio, 26.6-28.2% cyber) within expected variance for 50-sample subset. MCQ evaluation methodology is deterministic. Multiple test runs showed stable generation behavior.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: Demo notebook (notebooks/inference.ipynb) provided showing model loading and text generation. CodeWalkthrough.md provides usage examples. All demo steps executable without external materials. Pretrained models publicly available. Demo outputs match expected behavior (deflection on harmful prompts, normal responses on benign prompts).
